description.value: 30 cm (12") High-End woofer with black cellulose cone, large magnet and heavy aluminium die-cast basket. Extremely high power handling due to 60 mm voice-coil, capton voice coil carrier, vented damper and magnet vent. Easy connection due to the double voice coil (2 x 4 ohms) allowing the unit to be connected up for 2 ohm or 8 ohm use.
